pages.title: Christmas Night Windows Colouring Book
pages.concept: An arched cottage window opens onto a moonlit snowy village, introducing the magical after-dark Christmas theme.
pages.artwork_description: A grand arched window fills the page, framed by patterned curtains, a tied-back ribbon and a foreground evergreen wreath with berries and bells. Beyond it are snow-covered rooftops, glowing windows, a church spire, a crescent moon and falling snow. The title sits clearly in the upper arch.
pages.generation_prompt: Cover design with exact title text “Christmas Night Windows Colouring Book” in a small classic serif within the upper arch of a grand arched cottage window; foreground wreath, patterned curtains and ribbon tie-backs; beyond the glass, moonlit snowy village rooftops, church spire, crescent moon and falling snow.
pages.production_notes: Verify the title exactly. Keep the title large, high contrast and free of decorative pseudo-text. This is the cover; the supplied printing guide requires no separate artwork page.

pages.title: The Wreath Window
pages.concept: A welcoming living-room window with a large wreath as the focal object.
pages.artwork_description: Viewed from inside a cottage, a mullioned window is dressed with a full evergreen wreath, bow, orange slices and stars. A candle, teacup and knitted mittens rest on the sill; outside, snow gathers on a stone wall and bare branches.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Wreath Window”; inside-cottage viewpoint through a mullioned window, a large evergreen wreath with bow, orange slices and star ornaments centred on the glass; candle, teacup and knitted mittens on the sill; snowy stone wall and bare winter branches outside.
pages.production_notes: Maintain generous separate segments in the wreath and ornaments; use only sparse flame hatching.

pages.title: The Toymaker's Window
pages.concept: A festive toy-shop display seen from the pavement at night.
pages.artwork_description: A deep shopfront window contains a rocking horse, wooden train, nesting dolls, a drum, teddy bear and tiny wrapped parcels. A striped awning, garland and snow-topped window ledge frame the display, with a reflected crescent moon in the glass.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Toymaker’s Window”; exterior pavement view of a deep old-fashioned toy-shop window, with rocking horse, wooden train, nesting dolls, drum, teddy bear and wrapped parcels arranged on shelves; striped awning, garland, snowy ledge and crescent-moon reflection in the glass.
pages.production_notes: Ensure every toy is clearly outlined as an original generic object, with no branded designs or logos.

pages.title: Lantern at the Gate
pages.concept: An open garden gate creates a doorway-like threshold into a snowy home path.
pages.artwork_description: An ornate iron gate stands partly open beneath an arched trellis wrapped in holly and lights. A lantern hangs from the gatepost, leading the eye along stepping stones to a cottage door with a wreath; robins perch on the fence.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “Lantern at the Gate”; close foreground view through a partly open ornate iron garden gate under an arched trellis wrapped in holly and small lights; hanging lantern on gatepost; snowy stepping-stone path to a cottage door with wreath; two robins on a fence.
pages.production_notes: Keep gate bars broad enough to colour and maintain a clear path through the middle depth.

pages.title: The Bakery After Dark
pages.concept: A Christmas bakery window overflowing with festive treats and warm domestic detail.
pages.artwork_description: A paned bakery window displays iced gingerbread houses, loaves, cinnamon buns, a tiered cake, cookies and a handwritten-looking price board with no legible words. A rolling pin, wheat sheaf and holly decorate the frame; snowflakes drift outside.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Bakery After Dark”; exterior view into a paned Christmas bakery window displaying iced gingerbread houses, artisan loaves, cinnamon buns, tiered cake and decorated cookies; rolling pin, wheat sheaf and holly on the frame; use decorative blank price-board shapes with no readable writing; drifting snow.
pages.production_notes: Do not generate price text or pseudo-text. Keep icing patterns enclosed and colourable.

pages.title: The Attic Dormer
pages.concept: A cosy attic reading nook framed by a dormer window and snowy roofline.
pages.artwork_description: Inside an attic, a dormer window looks out over chimney pots and a star-filled night. A cushioned window seat holds an open book, folded quilt, cat, lantern and stack of parcels; patterned roof beams and hanging paper stars add detail.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Attic Dormer”; interior attic reading nook framed by a dormer window; open book, folded patchwork quilt, sleeping cat, lantern and stacked parcels on a cushioned window seat; exposed patterned roof beams and hanging paper stars; outside, snowy chimney pots and star-filled night.
pages.production_notes: Use a simple, original cat silhouette. Keep the book pages free of text.

pages.title: Florist in the Snow
pages.concept: A flower-shop window shows winter greenery and festive bouquets.
pages.artwork_description: A tall bowed shop window holds buckets of poinsettias, amaryllis, eucalyptus, holly, pinecones and ribboned bouquets. Outside, a bicycle with a basket leans near the doorway while snow blankets cobbles and window boxes.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “Florist in the Snow”; tall bowed flower-shop window filled with buckets of poinsettias, amaryllis, eucalyptus, holly, pinecones and ribboned bouquets; bicycle with basket beside the doorway; snowy cobblestones and window boxes.
pages.production_notes: Avoid identifying shop names. Make each plant group distinct with broad petal and leaf sections.

pages.title: A Candle in the Chapel
pages.concept: A view through ancient chapel doors towards a peaceful candlelit interior.
pages.artwork_description: Heavy wooden chapel doors stand open, framed by carved stone and ivy. Inside, rows of simple pews lead to a candlelit altar with a small wreath and tall arched windows; outside foreground snow and a lantern create depth.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “A Candle in the Chapel”; view through open heavy wooden chapel doors framed by carved stone and winter ivy; inside, simple pews leading to a candlelit altar with a small wreath and tall arched windows; snowy foreground and one lantern.
pages.production_notes: Use non-denominational seasonal architectural details; no religious text or symbols requiring precise reproduction.

pages.title: The Post Office Window
pages.concept: A village post office at Christmas with parcels, cards and a mailbag.
pages.artwork_description: A service-window display has a brass post slot, a canvas mailbag, string-tied parcels, envelopes, stamp-like decorative squares, a small scales and a tabletop tree. A streetlamp and snowy village lane recede beyond the side pane.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Post Office Window”; old village post-office display behind a service window, brass mail slot, canvas mailbag, string-tied parcels, envelopes, decorative stamp-like squares without lettering, small weighing scales and tabletop tree; side pane looks onto a snowy lane with streetlamp.
pages.production_notes: No logos, postal brands, addresses or readable envelope text. Keep stamp-like squares purely decorative.

pages.title: The Conservatory Tree
pages.concept: A glass conservatory frames a decorated tree against the dark winter garden.
pages.artwork_description: Viewed through open French doors, a conservatory contains a tall Christmas tree in a basket, paper chains, potted ferns, a wicker chair and a tray of cocoa. Panes reflect stars while frosted garden shrubs and a bird feeder sit beyond.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Conservatory Tree”; view through open French doors into a glass conservatory, tall decorated Christmas tree in a woven basket, paper chains, potted ferns, wicker chair and tray with cocoa mugs; pane reflections of stars; frosted shrubs and bird feeder outside.
pages.production_notes: Create large ornament sections and avoid dense pane-crossing detail that complicates colouring.

pages.title: The Watchmaker's Clock
pages.concept: A clockmaker's shop window adds intricate circular patterns and a midnight theme.
pages.artwork_description: A large ornate clock face with hands approaching midnight hangs behind the glass, surrounded by pocket watches, a pendulum clock, gears, keys and sprigs of holly. A snow-dusted streetlamp appears beyond the narrow side windows.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Watchmaker’s Clock”; shop window dominated by one large ornate clock face with hands at 11:55, surrounded by pocket watches, a pendulum clock, visible decorative gears, clock keys and holly sprigs; narrow side windows reveal a snow-dusted streetlamp.
pages.production_notes: Set all prominent clock hands clearly to 11:55. Gears must be decorative and not presented as a mechanism puzzle.

pages.title: Sled Beyond the Stable Door
pages.concept: An open stable door frames a horse, sleigh and snowy moonlit field.
pages.artwork_description: From inside a timber stable, the viewer sees a gentle horse in a stall, harness hooks, a lantern and hay bales. Through the open half-door sits a curled-up sleigh with blankets, leading to a moonlit field and fir trees.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “Sled Beyond the Stable Door”; interior stable threshold with timber beams, gentle horse in stall, harness hooks, lantern and hay bales; open half-door frames a curled-up sleigh with blankets, then a moonlit snowy field and fir trees.
pages.production_notes: Keep the horse calm and realistically proportioned in a simple storybook style; make harness straps sufficiently wide.

pages.title: The Bookshop at Midnight
pages.concept: A richly layered bookshop window with a festive reading scene.
pages.artwork_description: Shelves rise behind a bay window, holding blank-spined books, a ladder, globe, armchair, plaid throw and a tiny tree. A raven-shaped bookend and candle sit on a table, while snow falls across the reflected street outside.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Bookshop at Midnight”; bay-window view into a bookshop with tall shelves of blank-spined books, rolling ladder, globe, armchair with plaid throw, tiny Christmas tree, raven-shaped bookend and candle on a table; snowy street reflection on the glass.
pages.production_notes: All book spines must be blank or marked only with simple non-text decorative bands; no generated titles.

pages.title: The Bell Tower Door
pages.concept: A stone bell tower entrance opens onto a spiral stair and starry village skyline.
pages.artwork_description: A weathered arched door is open beneath a small hanging bell and evergreen swag. Inside, a spiral stone stair rises towards a bell chamber; beyond the threshold, tiny rooftops, distant hills and stars fill the lower view.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Bell Tower Door”; weathered arched stone bell-tower door standing open under a small hanging bell and evergreen swag; interior spiral stone staircase rising upward; threshold view includes tiny village rooftops, distant hills and stars.
pages.production_notes: Use clear stair treads and simple stone blocks; preserve a broad open doorway silhouette.

pages.title: The Winter Greenhouse
pages.concept: A greenhouse doorway opens into a lush, festive night garden.
pages.artwork_description: A greenhouse door is ajar, revealing shelves of citrus trees, herbs, bulbs, terracotta pots and a garlanded watering can. Panes show snow on the roof and a crescent moon; a hedgehog curls beside the doorstep.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Winter Greenhouse”; ajar greenhouse door revealing shelves of citrus trees, herbs, flowering bulbs, terracotta pots and a watering can draped with a small garland; panes show snowy roof and crescent moon; hedgehog curled beside the doorstep.
pages.production_notes: Keep foliage varied but grouped into colourable clusters; use no tiny individual leaf overload.

pages.title: The Market Stall
pages.concept: A striped market-stall canopy frames a bustling but peaceful Christmas market view.
pages.artwork_description: Seen from beneath a scalloped canopy, a stall displays knitted scarves, candles, jars, gingerbread and wreaths. In the distance, a fountain, striped awnings, villagers in simple winter coats and a tall tree create a layered market square.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Market Stall”; viewpoint from beneath a scalloped Christmas-market stall canopy, display of knitted scarves, candles, jars, gingerbread and wreaths; deep view to fountain, striped awnings, a few simply silhouetted winter-clad villagers and tall decorated tree.
pages.production_notes: Use no signs, brand names or price text. Limit distant figures to readable silhouettes with uncluttered faces.

pages.title: The Moonlit Train Window
pages.concept: A train-compartment window reveals a snowy journey through the countryside.
pages.artwork_description: Inside a vintage train compartment, a large window frames pine woods, a river bridge and a tiny station in moonlight. A luggage rack holds a plaid case and parcels; a table holds cocoa, a map with non-text lines and a sprig of holly.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Moonlit Train Window”; vintage train-compartment interior with a large window framing moonlit pine woods, river bridge and tiny snowy station; luggage rack with plaid suitcase and parcels; table with cocoa mugs, an unlabelled map of simple route lines and holly sprig.
pages.production_notes: Do not include railway logos, station names or map labels. Ensure window view reads clearly in receding layers.

pages.title: The Knitter's Bay Window
pages.concept: A domestic bay window frames handmade Christmas preparations.
pages.artwork_description: A bay window seat holds a basket of wool, needles, a partly knitted stocking, patchwork cushions and a sleeping dog. Paper snowflakes hang above; outside, neighbouring roofs carry snow and a glowing star ornament hangs across the lane.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Knitter’s Bay Window”; cosy bay-window seat with basket of wool balls, knitting needles, partly knitted stocking, patchwork cushions and sleeping dog; paper snowflakes overhead; outside are snowy neighbouring roofs and a hanging star ornament across the lane.
pages.production_notes: Keep yarn strands bold and organised rather than tangled; use an original generic stocking motif.

pages.title: The Seaside Cottage Door
pages.concept: A coastal Christmas doorway offers a change from village streets while retaining the night-window theme.
pages.artwork_description: A rounded cottage door with a rope-and-evergreen wreath opens towards a moonlit harbour. A lobster pot, anchor-shaped doorstop, lantern and striped scarf sit on the step; fishing boats and a lighthouse appear beyond snowy dunes.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Seaside Cottage Door”; rounded coastal cottage door with rope-and-evergreen wreath opening onto a moonlit harbour; lobster pot, anchor-shaped doorstop, lantern and striped scarf on the step; fishing boats, lighthouse and snowy dunes beyond.
pages.production_notes: Use generic fishing boats with no names or flags. Retain strong simple shapes in rope coils and lobster pot.

pages.title: The Grand Hotel Entrance
pages.concept: Elegant hotel doors frame a festive lobby and snowy carriage arrival.
pages.artwork_description: Tall double doors with etched glass stand open beneath a striped awning. Inside are a tiled lobby, potted palms, garland-wrapped banister and chandelier; outside, a horse-drawn carriage waits in snow beside ornamental planters.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Grand Hotel Entrance”; elegant tall double doors with decorative etched-glass patterns under a striped awning; view to tiled lobby, potted palms, garland-wrapped banister and chandelier; outside, a horse-drawn carriage in snow beside ornamental planters.
pages.production_notes: No hotel name or monogram. Keep etched glass as broad repeat patterns, not fragile micro-lines.

pages.title: The Music Room Window
pages.concept: An interior music room combines decorative instruments with snowy night views.
pages.artwork_description: A tall window behind an upright piano looks over a snowy garden. Sheet music is replaced by simple musical-note motifs, and the room holds a violin, cello, stool, candleholder, garland and a bowl of ornaments.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Music Room Window”; warm music-room interior with tall snowy-garden window behind an upright piano, violin, cello, stool, candleholder, garland and bowl of ornaments; piano stand shows only a few large simple musical-note motifs, no staff notation or text.
pages.production_notes: Avoid recognisable instrument brands and illegible score text. Make instrument outlines accurate and spacious.

pages.title: The Observatory Door
pages.concept: A domed observatory doorway looks towards a telescope and dramatic winter sky.
pages.artwork_description: A rounded observatory door opens to a telescope beneath a partial dome. Star charts with abstract constellations, a brass lantern and stacked books frame the foreground; through the opening, a comet crosses above snowy mountains.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Observatory Door”; rounded observatory doorway open to a telescope under a partially opened dome; foreground abstract star-chart circles without labels, brass lantern and stacked blank-spined books; outside, a comet above snowy mountains.
pages.production_notes: No astronomy labels or text. Constellations must be decorative, with simple clearly connected stars.

pages.title: The Village Hall Dance
pages.concept: Open hall doors reveal a restrained, festive social scene with depth and movement.
pages.artwork_description: Double doors open onto a village hall with a central tree, bunting, lanterns and a small band on a low stage. A few adults and teens in winter party clothes dance in simple pairs; tables hold punch bowls, biscuits and candles.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “The Village Hall Dance”; view through open village-hall double doors to a central Christmas tree, paper bunting, lanterns and a small band on a low stage; a few adults and teens in simple winter party clothes dancing in pairs; side tables with punch bowl, biscuits and candles.
pages.production_notes: Keep figures few, well-spaced and age-appropriate, with simple readable faces. No textual banner or song lyrics.

pages.title: Home Through the Window
pages.concept: A final peaceful homecoming scene closes the book with a view from snowy outdoors into a welcoming house.
pages.artwork_description: From a snow-covered garden path, the viewer looks through a large glowing cottage window into a room with a tree, armchair, stockings, sleeping cat and table laid for cocoa. Foreground fir branches, gateposts and falling snow create a layered final frame.
pages.generation_prompt: Exact small title text “Home Through the Window”; final exterior viewpoint from a snowy garden path looking through a large cottage window into a welcoming room with Christmas tree, armchair, simple stockings, sleeping cat and table set with cocoa; foreground fir branches, gateposts and falling snow frame the view.
pages.production_notes: Conclude with generous calm colourable areas and a strong focal window. Check all 24 pages are exported as single-sided pages; include the separate printing guide as a non-artwork deliverable.

selected_pages.reason: First illustration-led page (colouring): sets the core illustration style.
A different page type (colouring) tests a different layout and activity structure.
A later page (colouring, p24) checks the shared style stays consistent across the product.

images.prompt:
Original adult Christmas colouring-book art in expressive black fineliner on clean white paper: confident variable-weight contours, crisp hand-inked architectural detail, gentle organic curves, high but colourable patterned detail, spacious enclosed shapes, sparse contour hatching and stippling, selective black accents, deep layered storytelling, magical intimate winter-night mood, monochrome only, home-print-friendly.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Original festive adult colouring-book illustration in expressive black fineliner, combining cosy architectural storytelling with decorative seasonal pattern work.; line weight: Fine-to-medium variable black outlines, with slightly heavier outer contours and foreground framing elements.; line quality: Clean, confident hand-inked contours; gently imperfect organic curves; precise architectural marks; controlled short hatching.; detail level: High but colourable detail: layered environmental motifs, architectural trims and small festive accents balanced with generous enclosed areas for pencils and pens.; character language: Stylised storybook figures, if included, with simple readable silhouettes, warm restrained expressions and uncluttered facial features.; background density: Richly detailed, deep-view backgrounds built in receding layers; distant elements simplify to preserve clear focal areas.; composition: Framed-viewpoint compositions with a strong visual threshold, clear focal hierarchy, layered depth and deliberate breathing room within major colourable shapes.; palette: Monochrome artwork only; line design should support a colourist’s own winter-night palette of deep blue, evergreen, berry red, warm gold and soft ivory.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: Minimal contour-following hatching, sparse stippling and selective black fills to imply night-time contrast without pre-colouring or muddying the page.; texture: Crisp uncoated-paper ink feel, with patterned surface details expressed through simple repeatable marks rather than grey tonal rendering.; mood: Magical, intimate, nostalgic and quietly festive..

PAGE 2 of "Christmas Night Windows Colouring Book" (colouring): Exact small title text “The Wreath Window”; inside-cottage viewpoint through a mullioned window, a large evergreen wreath with bow, orange slices and star ornaments centred on the glass; candle, teacup and knitted mittens on the sill; snowy stone wall and bare winter branches outside.
